test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who abandons religion
solution:
The correct answer is "**Apostate.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given words:
 
 
• Egotist is a noun that refers to a person who is excessively conceited or self-centered.
 
• Priest is a noun that refers to a religious leader who performs sacred ceremonies and offers spiritual guidance.
 
• ** Apostate is a noun that refers to a person who abandons a religious or political belief or principle.**
 
 
• **​Thus, it can substitute the given phrase.**
 
• Example: After years of practicing Islam, he became an apostate and left the religion altogether.
 
 
 
• ​​ Atheist is a noun that refers to a person who does not believe in the existence of God or gods.
 
 

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
